source_refs.title: Use magnification on your screen
source_refs.applicability: Android; the page says some steps require Android 13 or later without naming which steps
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android: 1. Open your device's Settings app. 2. Tap Accessibility, then Magnification. 3. Turn on Magnification shortcut. 4. Optionally, tap Magnification shortcut to choose a trigger. Accessibility button: uses the Accessibility icon at the bottom of the screen. The button's position can vary with your navigation setup. Hold volume keys: press and hold both volume keys. Triple-tap screen: quickly tap the screen 3 times and hold the gesture. This shortcut may slow down your device.

source_refs.title: Use magnification on your screen
source_refs.section: Using magnification: Full screen (zoom in and make everything bigger)
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Pinch with 2 fingers to adjust zoom.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android: 1. Tap the Accessibility icon, or your custom shortcut. 2. Tap anywhere except the keyboard or navigation bar. 3. Drag with 2 fingers to move around the screen. 4. Pinch with 2 fingers to adjust the zoom. 5. Use your magnification shortcut again to stop. Magnification can go up to 8x.

source_refs.title: Zoom in or magnify your Chromebook screen
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Under Display, turn on Full screen magnifier.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Chromebook: 1. Select the time at the bottom right, or press Alt + Shift + S. 2. Select Settings, then Accessibility. 3. Under 'Display', turn on 'Full screen magnifier'. 4. Choose how the magnified view moves with your mouse: 'Move screen continuously as mouse moves', 'Move screen keeping mouse at center of screen', or 'Move screen when mouse touches edge of screen'.

source_refs.title: Zoom in or magnify your Chromebook screen
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Increase magnification: Press Ctrl + Alt + Brightness up.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Chromebook: Under 'Change the magnification level': to increase magnification, press Ctrl + Alt + Brightness up. source_refs.model_visible_text: On Windows 11: To turn Magnifier on, press Windows key+Plus sign (+). To turn Magnifier off, press Windows key+Esc. If screens are locked, the first press releases the locks.
